event.description: Test adjacent block-0 pre-FF bias coordinate 2
event.proposal: Family: scalar pruning. Current retained frontier is 2,120 parameters at 99.200000%, a +0.200000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 14 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0048 at 2,120 parameters and 99.20%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0052, where blocks.0.ln2 coordinate 13 scored 98.99%, one case below qualification. The adjacent original-magnitude candidate is blocks.0.ln2 coordinate 2 at -0.019955626. Hypothesis: nearly equal magnitude does not imply equal functional leverage, and independently zeroing coordinate 2 may preserve qualification while yielding 2,119 parameters. This is more informative than moving to a larger-magnitude site because it provides a controlled within-layer, within-normalizer comparison against attempt-0052.
